thread:
nina: quick heads-up — planning to enable the `weighted_routing_guard` runtime toggle tonight. want to validate dry-run visibility + explicit approval gating first.
ops-bot: deployment window requested 23:00-23:45 PT
omar: thumbs-up. SRE wants exact abort thresholds documented. can we keep them strict for the first hour?
pete: propose rollout: dry-run 3% for 20m, then 8% for 30m. abort if p95 latency +12% OR 5xx delta >0.4% OR route_mismatch_ratio > 0.75%.
rae: we should have a non-blocking dry_run endpoint that returns both chosen and candidate backend per request. add `dry_run=compare` to /api/configs/preview.
vince: telemetry: include `dry_run_id`, `config_rev`, `candidate_backend`, `chosen_backend`, and `mismatch_tag`. sample full payloads 0.5% and counters 100%.
nina: console: add small preview toggle labeled "Compare mode" visible to config authors. show mismatch_ratio and a one-click "export samples (100)" restricted to authors+platform.
pete: runbook single-line rollback please so SRE can execute fast.
nina: use this (dry-run first):
```
# rollback to previous rev
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.internal/api/configs/rollback \
  -d '{"config_name":"weighted_routing_guard","to_rev":"rev-2026-03-15-0945"}'
```
omar: add a quick monitor-check script that runs after rollback and prints p50/p95 + mismatch_ratio for last 10m. i'll keep it handy.
rae: governance: PR must include `activation_playbook.md` link and `rollout_window` label. require author + platform approver (one of platform leads) before console toggle is allowed. backend will return 403 if approvals missing.
vince: UI: i'll surface "activation blocked: approvals_needed=1" with a tooltip linking to PR and playbook. also show who approved + timestamp.
pete: small ops ask — can we compute mismatch_ratio within 20s? quick checks are helpful while deciding to abort.
vince: yes, we'll pre-aggregate per `dry_run_id` and expose a fast endpoint the console can poll.
nina: final checklist: 1) rae: update PR gating docs, 2) vince: trace attrs + console preview + fast mismatch endpoint, 3) pete: runbook + monitor script & oncall, 4) omar: PR review by 21:30 PT.
ops-bot: deployment window tentatively scheduled 23:00-23:45 PT
omar: i'll be oncall standby. include contact block in runbook (pager + slack dms).
rae: also add a lightweight alert query (off by default) for mismatch_ratio > 0.6% so authors can opt-in after validation.
nina: perfect. i'll post the short RFC + runbook link in #eng-platform and pin. flag here if anything else before 20:15 PT. :thumbsup:
